programmes.t: Sam Tallent: Waiting for Death to Claim Us
programmes.d: Follows stand-up scion Sam Tallent through 13 different venues across the US from sold-out theaters to house parties and rib-joints, all the while COVID barrels down on the nation in early 2020.
The comic tackles off-limits issues including Boko Haram, racism and her own sexuality.

programmes.t: Kevin Smith: Silent But Deadly Extended Edition
programmes.d: Kevin Smith is anything but quiet in this new comedy special that was recorded an hour before his heart attack in February; before he nearly died backstage, onstage he discusses his marriage, his kid and his work (or lack thereof).

programmes.t: Lavell Crawford I Could Eat Part 2
programmes.d: Meat's on the menu with Lavell Crawford keeping Burger King humble to their have it your way slogan, godless vegetarians, and why the best chicken is from a house of God.

programmes.t: Denise Winkelman: Bougie on a Budget
programmes.d: Denise Winkelman mixes sharp wit and heartfelt humor as she shares her journey from a small town with hick parents to life as a transgender woman in Los Angeles, turning struggles into comedy.
The comic performs.

Famed Latino comedian and voiceover artist Jeff Garcia performs his signature improv style at San Manuel Indian Bingo and Casino. He comments on his family, unreliable cars, white people, marriage and his run-ins with the law.
Comic Jim Gaffigan proves that laughter is the best medicine when he talks about a family medical crisis and other topics during his hilarious stand-up routine.
The comic uses his signature everyman humor to deal with the unthinkable; filmed at the State Theatre in Minneapolis.
The comic discusses his crazy world of family, friends, and world travels.
Ventriloquist and stand-up comedian Jeff Dunham performs an all-Valentine's Day-themed special.
Filmed at the Fox Theater in Bakersfield, California the comedian and well-known favorite to television viewers as being on "Last Comic Standing," performs impressions and silly voices.

programmes.t: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map
programmes.d: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs across five continents, accompanied by his well-known characters, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, Peanut, Jose Jalapeño, Bubba J and Walter.

programmes.t: Gabriel Iglesias: I'm Not Fat... I'm Fluffy
programmes.d: The comic known for wearing his signature Hawaiian shirts covers everything from his fondness for Paul Rodriguez to his own "fluffiness."

From the Neptune Theater in Seattle, the comic talks about his interactions with immigrant parents, gives his thoughts on Matt Damon and asks whether ghosts are likely to haunt one-bedroom apartments.
Sara Huntington shows off the stand-up skills behind her TikTok and Instagram accounts in her debut special from Columbus, Ohio.
Chris Porter of Last Comic Standing performs his comedy routine in Kansas City.

programmes.t: Chris Porter: A Man From Kansas
programmes.d: Chris Porter discusses everything from hipsters ruining food, to being a man, to playing beer pong with celebrities, in his 3rd one-hour special.

Leanne Morgan gives an honest look at suburban life and the challenges of keeping her husband happy while juggling kids, dogs, and cheerleading camp.
Comedian Shayne Smith shares stories about everything from a failed robbery to a wrestling match in the New York Subway and even saving the life of a dog in this stand-up special.
